headword: {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}

definitions.gloss: the 24 solar terms; the 24 seasonal divisions
definitions.explanation: A traditional East Asian system that divides the solar year into 24 segments, each marking a specific seasonal change. Used historically for agriculture and still referenced in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦{立春|りっしゅん}→立春：22417_risshun⟧」⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: One of the 24 solar terms is 'Risshun' (Start of Spring).

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The 24 solar terms are still used in the Japanese calendar.

examples.japanese: {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もともと⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧{暦法|れきほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{農作業|のうさぎょう}→農作業：14511_nousagyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目安|めやす}→目安：00276_meyasu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{重宝|ちょうほう}→重宝：14415_chouhou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: The 24 solar terms originated in China as a calendar system and have long been valued as a guide for agricultural work.

notes:
A compound of {二十四|にじゅうし} (twenty-four) and {節気|せっき} (seasonal division). This system divides the solar year into 24 equal segments of approximately 15 days each, marking transitions in weather, daylight, and natural phenomena.

Well-known terms from the {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき} that appear in everyday Japanese include ⟦{立春|りっしゅん}→立春：22417_risshun⟧ (Start of Spring), ⟦{春分|しゅんぶん}→春分：19942_shunbun⟧ (Vernal Equinox), ⟦{夏至|げし}→夏至：19819_geshi⟧ (Summer Solstice), ⟦{秋分|しゅうぶん}→秋分：19657_shuubun⟧ (Autumnal Equinox), ⟦{冬至|とうじ}→冬至：11756_touji⟧ (Winter Solstice), and {大寒|だいかん} (Major Cold). These terms frequently appear on calendars, in weather reports, and in seasonal greetings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one of the 24 solar terms
- {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: in accordance with the solar terms
- {二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{七十二候|しちじゅうにこう}: the 24 solar terms and 72 micro-seasons

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {節気|せっき}: seasonal division — a single term within the 24-term system
- {雑節|ざっせつ}: miscellaneous seasonal days — supplementary seasonal markers outside the 24 terms (e.g., ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧, ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧)
- ⟦{旧暦|きゅうれき}→旧暦：12958_kyuureki⟧: the old lunar calendar — the traditional lunisolar calendar in which these terms were embedded
